## Change

Describe the problem and resulting behavior. Link the issue if relevant.

## Verification

List the checks actually run and their results. For UI changes, note compact/expanded layouts, larger text, and keyboard behavior where relevant. Include redacted screenshots if useful. State any checks you could not run and whether live account access was used.

## Limits and follow-up

Note remaining gaps, API constraints, or documentation changes a reviewer should know about.

- [ ] No credentials, private account data, build products, or signing material are included.
- [ ] Relevant documentation and third-party notices are updated.
